handback.summary: Workflows now read test commands, test folder, branches and bot from the settings, through a new settings mode.

criteria.795.1: `full-suite.yml` reads `TESTS_RUN_ALL` from `python3 -m dokima.settings env` and runs it; old readers keep the old command.
criteria.795.2: `acceptance-criteria.yml` reads `TESTS_RUN_ONE` from main's reader and fills `{test}` with the report flags and tests.
criteria.795.3: With `tests.affected: all`, `agent.yml` skips the baseline and runs every test; `testmon.yml` skips testmon and the cache save.
criteria.795.4: `agent.yml` Starting branch uses `TESTS_DIR` for main's tests on a planner clash and for the worker's kept tests.
criteria.795.6: `env_lines` adds one `--deselect` per `tests.exclude` entry to the all-tests command; default list is empty.
criteria.795.7: `agent.yml` merges, branches from and opens pull requests on `DEFAULT_BRANCH`; `fix.yml` lists and opens against it.
criteria.795.8: `agent.yml` saves the conversation on `RECORDS_BRANCH` and builds `LOG_URL` on it.
criteria.795.9: The code-owner gate lets only `${BOT_SLUG}[bot]` send the next-step signal.
criteria.795.10: Starting branch merges and `wiki.yml` commit as the settings' bot, its id looked up on GitHub.

raises.label: Record files stay
raises.text: Run records are still saved to and read from the logs branch, so a renamed records branch splits conversations from records.
